class MoveAlongPathExample(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        d1 = Dot().set_color(ORANGE)
        l1 = Line(LEFT, RIGHT)
        l2 = VMobject()
        self.add(d1, l1, l2)
        l2.add_updater(lambda x: x.become(Line(LEFT, d1.get_center()).set_color(ORANGE)))
        self.play(MoveAlongPath(d1, l1), rate_func=linear)
